common.notDeployedTitle: This module’s database update has not been applied
common.notDeployedText: The related Supabase migration (20261007…) has not been applied to the live database yet, so this screen cannot load data. Retry after it is applied.

segments.title: Segments
segments.desc: Living parent segments by behavior, plan and grade. Consent exclusion and per-family de-duplication are automatic.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.desc: Draft, pre-flight check and scheduling are separate steps. Saving a draft is not sending.

journeys.title: Automations
journeys.desc: Design parent journeys with trigger, wait, condition and message steps; see the path with a dry run.

surveys.title: Forms & surveys
surveys.desc: NPS and satisfaction surveys, conditional questions and anonymity. A low score only opens a support review task.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.desc: Read commercial growth and learning behavior separately and together.

team.title: Team & permissions
team.desc: Staff, the planned role model and an immutable audit trail.

channels.title: Channel settings
channels.desc: Consent, quiet hours and frequency policy plus provider connection status.

profile.demoNote: Nothing is saved in demo mode.
profile.consentHint: Default: no consent. Every change is written to the audit log with its reason; consent is re-checked at send time.
profile.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Parent gave written consent by phone
profile.notePlaceholder: Add a short note for the team...

export.demo: Export is disabled in demo mode.
export.title: Export parent list
export.text: Contains personal data. Your reason and the row count are written to the audit log. The current search filter applies.
export.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Monthly list for accounting reconciliation

segments.demo: Nothing is saved in demo mode.
segments.rules: The target is the parent; a family with several children is one recipient. Children cannot be segmented for commercial messages. Consent is re-checked at send time.
segments.name: Segment name
segments.starterText: Waiting for first task · Renewal approaching · Inactive for 7 days. Target by need; do not turn children into commercial scores.

campaigns.demo: Nothing is saved in demo mode.
campaigns.workerText: “Scheduled” is an intent record; no message is sent. The sender worker (lease, retry, send-time consent/frequency checks) arrives in a separate sprint.
campaigns.rhythmDesc: Consent, quiet hours and total channel frequency are evaluated together.

form.name: Campaign name
form.title: Title
form.draftNote: Saving a draft does not send. If content or audience changes, the pre-flight check must be rerun.
form.titleSample: This week’s learning summary is ready
form.messageSample: See the topics your child progressed in on your parent panel.

campaigns.preflightNote: Quiet hours are evaluated in the server time zone (Europe/Istanbul). A pre-flight is valid for 1 hour.
campaigns.preflightPlanned: Campaign scheduled. No message is sent until the sender worker is connected.

surveys.demo: Nothing is saved in demo mode.
surveys.tasksNote: In an identified survey, NPS 0–6 only opens a support review task; it never creates an automatic discount, offer or marketing consent.

form.name: Survey title
form.anonymousHelp: Responses are not linked to a CRM contact and time is rounded to the day. Cannot be changed once responses exist.
form.anonymousLocked: Anonymity cannot be changed because responses exist.
form.rules: A survey response does not replace marketing consent. Changing questions in a live survey creates a new version; responses stay bound to their own version.
form.previewNote: Preview · no response is sent. Pick an NPS score to try the conditional question.

res.npsNote: {n} valid NPS responses. NPS = (promoters − detractors) / responses × 100.
res.textsNote: Text responses are shown without identity.

journeys.demo: Nothing is saved in demo mode.
journeys.workerText: Automations are stored as draft/ready; no message is produced or sent. A dry run only shows the path of the definition.
journeys.pick: Pick a journey on the left or create a new one.

form.name: Journey name
form.saveNote: Saving creates a new version and returns the journey to draft. “Ready” needs at least one message step.

dry.title: Dry run
dry.note: Choose the situations below and see the path the journey would take. Nothing is actually sent.

lines.consentNo: No consent → exit, no message produced.
lines.goal_ilk_gorev_tamamlandi: First task completed → goal reached, exit.

funnel.title: Activation funnel
funnel.note: Steps follow the same sign-up cohort; rates are volatile on small samples. This is not a causal claim.

cohort.title: Return to learning
cohort.desc: Weekly student cohort · share who solved at least one question each week
cohort.note: Immature weeks stay “—”; they are not read as zero retention. Based on first-answer dates.

learning.title: Learning indicators
learning.active7: Active students in the last 7 days
learning.note: XP and time are not presented as learning gain. Reports must carry the measure definition, data time and sample size.

team.membersDesc: Accounts with the admin or teacher role.
team.roleNote: Roles are changed in the database only; the UI cannot assign roles.

matrix.title: Role matrix
matrix.note: This matrix is a design proposal and is not enforced yet. Today only admin and teacher roles exist; real authorization must be enforced in the API and database policies.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.desc: Actor and time are recorded for role changes, publishing, refunds, consent changes and exports.

channels.demo: Nothing is saved in demo mode.
channels.limitDesc: ±7-day window per parent (0 = no commercial messages)
channels.policyNote: 3 / 7 days and 20:00–09:00 are starting proposals, not an approved live policy. Changes are written to the audit log.
channels.statesNote: Provider acceptance, device delivery and reading are different states; once providers are connected each channel will show the states it can measure.

recon.notDeployed: The database update for the reconciliation check has not been applied.
recon.title: Reconciliation check
recon.desc: Lists inconsistencies between payment, subscription and access records.

types.suresi_gecmis_aktif: Active subscription past its end date

recon.note: This check does not verify provider events (no provider connected); it only looks at consistency between records.
